description: This file implements an Express middleware for Cognito/JWKS-based authentication, including token extraction, verification (via JWKS or fallback), and attaching user info to the request object.

methods.name: fetchJson
methods.description: Fetches JSON data from a URL with in-memory caching to avoid frequent JWKS pulls.

methods.name: getJwks
methods.description: Retrieves JWKS keys from the configured URL, using cache if valid.

methods.name: jwkToPem
methods.description: Converts a JWK RSA key to PEM format for verification.

methods.name: getPemForKid
methods.description: Finds the PEM key corresponding to a given key ID (kid) from JWKS.

methods.name: extractToken
methods.description: Extracts Bearer token or id_token from request headers, body, or query.

methods.name: verifyOrDecodeToken
methods.description: Verifies JWT using JWKS or decodes it in dev mode if JWKS is not configured.

methods.name: resolveTenantId
methods.description: Determines tenant ID from payload, headers, or environment variable.

methods.name: cognitoAuthMiddleware
methods.description: Express middleware that authenticates requests using Cognito/JWKS, attaching user info to the request object.
